messages.subject: Issue with panting costs in endotherm model
parts:
Dear endotherm model users,
Liang Ma just alerted me to an error (thanks!) in the coding of the panting costs in endoR_devel and in the associated endoR functions, which actually resulted in them being subtracted rather than added (blush). It is fixed now and pushed to github. This issue would mean that if you were simulating panting and had left the PANT_MULT at its default value, you would have underestimated the actual heat load a little bit (by 5%) and hence underestimated the water costs of this.
My apologies for any problems this has caused.
All the best,
Mike
